title: Perplexity Computer Runs Fully Local on Mac Without Cloud Inference
summary:
The AI's model and agent now execute entirely on a user's device in the latest update of the company's macOS application. This shift allows Perplexity Computer to interact with native apps and local files without transmitting sensitive user data to external servers for processing.

The system no longer requires cloud-based inference and can operate without a WiFi connection. The local functionality is available now for users through the Perplexity Mac app.
